title: Zuno Agent Prompt (OKF v0.2 Markdown bundle frontmatter)
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of agents/<name>/prompts/<task>.md (ADR-0038). The Markdown body (everything after the frontmatter block) is the literal prompt text - typically a system prompt for the matching task under agents/<name>/tasks/<task>.md. Consumed by Agent Runtime's AgentRegistry (ADR-0039) so a prompt edit changes agent behavior without a source-code change.
